scope: Reads existing actual destination output and delivered MP4. Compares every spoken PCM sample to the loaded browser voice buffer, including mono-to-stereo upmix. Independently decodes MP4 AAC and compares its entire spoken interval. Source-buffer oracles are never used to construct output media.

history.text: Attention, passengers. We are now approaching the final station of this line. Please take your belongings and prepare to exit from the platform on the right. Thank you, meow...
Attention, passengers. We are now approaching the final station of this line. Please take your belongings and prepare to exit from the platform on the right. Thank you, meow...

history.speaker: Rover
history.text: (I... I fell asleep on the train? Looks like this is the end of the line. I'd better get off...)

history.speaker: Narrator
history.text: The other passengers seem to have left long ago, leaving the train car empty but for you. You glance around, gather your few belongings, and step out.

history.speaker: Narrator
history.text: An aqua-blue butterfly flutters from a gap in the luggage rack. It lingers in the empty car for a moment, then gently follows in your wake.

history.speaker: Narrator
history.text: The hum of a radio broadcast, the rain-drenched scent of grass and trees on the wind, and a clear sky unbroken by a single skyscraper...

history.speaker: Narrator
history.text: After eight long hours of travel, you're back in the small town where you lived as a child. For the next year, this will be your home.

history.speaker: Rover
history.text: (After getting off, head straight along the sidewalk to reach the reception area. Someone will be waiting by the second pillar to the right of the reception desk.)

history.speaker: Rover
history.text: Right, this should be the place from the message. But... nobody's here.

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: Excuse me? Your Uncle Abby's been waiting for thirty minutes already.

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: Hey, over here! Quit gawking. I'm right here—look down!

history.speaker: Rover
history.text: Y-you... you can talk? Sorry, I thought you were a plushie someone left here. You're, uh... Abby?

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: P-Plushie?! Kids these days. Zero respect for their elders!

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: ...Hah. Whatever. Guess it makes sense you don't remember me. Been years. Come on, we'll catch up in the car.

history.speaker: Rover
history.text: Abby... uh, Uncle Abby? Have we met before?

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: Are you kidding me? I held you when you were a baby! Here, hand me your luggage.

history.speaker: Rover
history.text: (Feels like I just gained memories that don't exist... Were Abby and I really that close?)

history.speaker: Rover
history.text: (Abby, Abby... Ab...xasra? Abraxas? Abracadabra?)

history.speaker: Narrator
history.text: You can't say why, but... somehow, that's just how Abby's name is supposed to feel.

history.speaker: Narrator
history.text: As for why you can't remember anything from before, it's likely because you slept through the entire train ride when you first arrived here. Hard to make sense of anything while you're still dreaming.

history.speaker: Narrator
history.text: Paying no mind to your bewildered look, Abby turns around, grabs hold of a suitcase three times its size, and hauls it forward with all its might—advancing a legendary four inches.

history.speaker: Rover
history.text: Um, I'll just carry it myself. Uncle... Abby.

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: Welcome to your new home. Like what you see?

history.speaker: Rover chose
history.text: It's a nice place. I like it.

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: Heh-heh. 'Course it is. I spent all weekend tidying it all up!

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: Anyway, here's your key. This room's yours for the next year.

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: Decor, furniture, hosting friends... that's all your call.

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: I'm pretty chill as far as guardians go. But you've got an exam to worry about. So don't stay out too late, or I might have to tighten the purse strings.

history.speaker: Rover chose
history.text: Do you know my family well, Abby?

history.speaker: Narrator
history.text: Abby blinks at your question for a second, then gives a firm, emphatic nod.

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: 'Course I do! They wouldn't have shipped you off to me otherwise. Hang on... they didn't mention me at all, did they?

history.speaker: Rover
history.text: ...Maybe I just forgot.

history.speaker: Abby
history.text: All right. Get settled in. Fifteen minutes, and I'm taking you to try out some of the local specialties.

history.speaker: Chisa
history.text: Here is your beef and tofu hotpot, Principal. Dipping sauces and drinks are over there. And this... is an automatic hotpot defoaming device I developed based on suggestions from my classmates.

history.speaker: Narrator
history.text: After setting the dishes on the table, the black-haired girl in a school uniform brings out a strange device attached to a motor.

history.speaker: Chisa
history.text: Would you like to try it? It's a two-part design, fully powered and highly efficient. I made sure it's completely safe this time. Still, please watch your fingers when you—
